questions.stem: A patient presents immediately after a potentially rabies-exposing dog bite at a remote clinic. Neither soap nor an antiviral wound-cleansing agent is available. While urgent post-exposure prophylaxis is arranged, what should be done to the wound now?

options.text: Leave it untouched until soap becomes available
Wash the wound thoroughly and extensively with the available water
Cover it dry without cleansing to preserve the wound surface
Close the wound immediately before any cleansing

questions.explanation: Do not defer local cleansing when soap or an antiviral agent is unavailable: wash thoroughly and extensively with water. Arrange urgent assessment for indicated post-exposure prophylaxis; water-only cleansing is not a substitute for it.
